title: Mrs. Cho's Late Husband

objectives.text: Ask the projectionist about the reel

rewards.text: Her late husband's watch (sell or keep); the Velvet Moon midnight screening unlocked
rewards.payNote: The watch (sellable for about $300 at the pawnshop) instead of cash.

where: The Velvet Moon and the Deuce's 24-hour cinemas
mobile: No timers; marquees are readable from the sidewalk.
laterParts: Part 2: Match marquees to reels across the Deuce cinemas and persuade the projectionist to run the scene.
Part 3: Give Mrs. Cho one more evening watching him on screen; the Velvet Moon midnight screening opens.
